query:
DELETE FROM oauth_refresh_tokens r
           WHERE r.org_id = $1
             AND r.family_id IN (
                 SELECT f.family_id FROM oauth_refresh_tokens f
                 WHERE f.org_id = $1
                 GROUP BY f.family_id
                 HAVING max(f.expires_at)
                        <= timestamptz 'epoch' + $2::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'
             )
